source:
@@U01731@@
Haven't you any jewelry for her?

@@U01733@@
Oh, I think I might have. A string of pearls? Who knows?

@@U01735@@
It pains me to go without a gift.

@@U01737@@
Silly boy, what makes you think you always have to pay? But look! There’s a sky full of stars! I'll sing you a masterpiece! A moral song, just for her, the better to seduce her by.

@@U01738@@
(He sings to a zither.)

@@U01739@@
Katie, dear Katie, At break of day You stand at your true love's door. O never begin, No, never give in! He'll lift the pin And a maid goes in, But a maid, no, nevermore. Young men will do it, If they come to it, And good girls do not linger! So, Katie, be wise, Believe no lies, Hide your prize From lovers’ eyes, Till you have a ring on your finger!
translation:
@@U01731@@
你没有给她买首饰吗？

@@U01733@@
哦，我想我可能有。一串珍珠？谁知道？

@@U01735@@
没有礼物就走让我很痛苦。

@@U01737@@
傻孩子，是什么让你觉得你总是要付出代价？但是看！那里满天都是星星！我给你唱一首杰作！一首道德歌曲，只为她而唱，更好地诱惑她。

@@U01738@@
（他用古筝唱歌。）

@@U01739@@
凯蒂，亲爱的凯蒂，黎明时分，你站在你真爱的门口。哦，永远不要开始，不，永远不要屈服！他会举起别针，一个女仆进去，但一个女仆，不，再也不会了。年轻人会这样做，如果他们愿意的话，而好女孩不会流连！所以，凯蒂，要明智，不要相信谎言，把你的奖品隐藏起来，不让恋人看到，直到你的手指上戴上戒指！
